title: Every clock time Claude shows the owner names its time zone and uses the 24-hour clock
why: Owner ruling, Nov 2 13:10 CST, relayed by the coordinator, verbatim: "make it known that every time claude ever speaks to me about time it specifies the time zone and uses 24 hour time". The ruling's home is decision local-time-central (docs/decisions/local-time-central.md).
note: Fix: decision local-time-central rewrites its ruling in place to add "every time named carries its zone, not once per message (owner, 2026-11-02 13:10 CST)". Rule style-time-central-24h in output-styles/shiv-stylisms.md changes from "with the zone named once" to "with the zone named on every time". Check: lint/report_guard.py (the Stop report guard) refuses a clock time HH:MM with no zone after it. Red test first: a reply with "13:10" alone is refused; "13:10 CST" passes. Test for false alarms: a version such as 1.12:30, a ratio, a time inside a code span, and a range such as "12:15 and 12:25 CST" (decide in the lane: each time takes its own zone, per the ruling's "every time"). Also refuse a 12-hour form ("1:10 pm"). Basis: owner ruling. Port: yes, the output style and report guard are shared. Ready.
